name: silence-60s
recorded_from: synthetic, from uspace-lab schemas/common examples at LAB_COMMIT; no system serves the console frame yet (README.md: replace with a recording)
description: A connection that goes silent: status and snapshot on connect, then sixty seconds with no frame of any kind, not even the status frame due every 2 s, then one status frame. The server never closes the socket; the client gives it up at its silence bound, so the last frame is delivered to the socket it opens next.
